description: This is a modern, black futon-style sofa with a sleek design. It features a tufted seat and backrest, upholstered in what appears to be faux leather, giving it a slightly glossy finish. The frame and armrests are made of dark wood, with a slatted design on the armrests adding a contemporary touch. The sofa's low profile and minimalist aesthetic make it a versatile piece for various living spaces, suitable for both lounging and sleeping.
